historical_reviews.deepseek: Generic decode guidance cannot establish a cumulative bad-page threshold or protect arbitrary addresses.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats repeated injection as critical but assumes three listed addresses correspond to the approved threshold sequence.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row120 tests one poison consumption event; this case must prove cumulative bad-page policy transition. Row122 concerns a link BER threshold, not memory page retirement.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Threshold testing requires known initial count, policy threshold, per-address eligibility and a monotonic event timeline ending exactly at the approved transition.

original_test_intent: Create controlled deferred errors on approved device3 UMC pages until the platform's bad-page threshold is exceeded, decode the fresh threshold event per table6.5, and verify page retirement/fatal policy plus complete recovery without damaging unrelated memory.
original_method: Resolve target/component and threshold policy; map device3 to UUID/BDF/OAM/socket and each raw address to disposable VRAM pages; baseline device3 bad-page/retired-page count and decode cursor; inject one approved page at a time with readback after each; stop immediately at the expected transition; decode the complete record; preserve retired-page state and perform owner-approved cleanup/recovery and data-integrity checks.
manual_activity: The GPU memory-RAS owner proves every address is a disposable device3 page, defines the threshold/count policy and retirement recovery, approves each step and stops the sequence at the first transition.
required_inputs: Approved amdgpuras build/version/checksum and full guide table6.5 schema
Stable device3 UUID/BDF/OAM/socket plus UMC block0/method5/type4 semantics and SDMA Script reconciliation
Bad-page threshold value, initial count, event-counting rules, persistence and expected severity/action
Vendor-approved mapping and ownership for 0x10000/0x11000/0x12000 or replacement addresses; page size/alignment and disposable data proof
Expected per-injection counter/page-retirement delta and complete threshold-exceeded decoded fields
Early-stop, fatal/reset, spare exhaustion, poison/page cleanup, reboot and restoration criteria
safety_requirements: Never inject the literal raw addresses until device3 ownership, alignment and non-production allocation are proven
Use dedicated idle GPU/host, verified disposable data and independent console/OOB
Do not clear bad-page history or reload shared driver without approval; capture initial persistent threshold/retirement state
Serialize one address at a time, inspect state after each and stop immediately on threshold event or unexpected fatal/reset
No automatic retries or additional addresses after transition; preserve evidence and follow owner-approved page/GPU recovery
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool/guide, target/component, raw-page ownership, threshold policy and recovery readiness
Collect read-only initial state and, after separate approval, per-address transcript/counter/decode evidence
Do not choose or reuse addresses, batch injections, infer threshold, clear retirement state, reload driver, reset/reboot, recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve target/Script/baseline conflicts and approve safe address list
Define threshold arithmetic, expected event fields and early-stop point
Manage page retirement/cleanup/recovery and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It describes the category but omits the literal addresses, accumulation policy and destructive threshold transition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after address and threshold approval, run the source commands serially—not as a loop—with state/decode checks after each and stop at the approved threshold transition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: modprobe, device0 UMC query, device3/block0/method5/type4, three example addresses/order, device3 decode, table6.5, Fatal sample header, SDMA Script and 30/30-minute scope remain disputed source inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Advance a known device3 bad-page count one approved disposable page at a time, prove the exact threshold transition and full record, then preserve/clean page state under owner control.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds address ownership, starting count, threshold arithmetic, per-step observation, early stop and persistent retired-page recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three successful injections and a Fatal JSON header do not prove the threshold was crossed or that the correct pages were retired.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad-page retirement may persist across reboot and consume finite spare capacity; arbitrary addresses can corrupt active GPU data.

project_override_considerations: Literal sample BDF5c:00.0/socket3, addresses and record_id are not reusable without the current recipe map. The project must decide whether the SDMA-named Script is erroneous or wraps the stated UMC operation.
expected_evidence: Resolved UMC/SDMA target, tool/guide provenance and full table6.5 schema
UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/device3, raw-address-to-disposable-page mapping, page alignment and data hashes
Initial bad-page/retired-page/threshold state, decode cursor, logs and OOB readiness
Per-address exact transcript with counter/page delta, target correlation and stop decision
Fresh complete threshold-exceeded record containing the approved severity/action and explicit threshold indication
Persistent retirement/poison status, cleanup/recovery/reboot, data/GPU/host health, restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Baseline queries device0 while all injections/decode use device3; command is UMC block0 but Script name says SDMA. The threshold and starting count are absent, and the sample shows only the first injection plus a truncated Fatal record with no threshold-exceeded field.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bad-page threshold intent and candidate sequence are identifiable. Engineering can supply safe pages, threshold policy and complete oracle before execution.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row121 Wistron-GPU RAS-00022-V003: reconcile device0 baseline versus device3 and UMC block0/method5/type4 versus SDMA Script; prove ownership/alignment/safety of 0x10000/0x11000/0x12000 or provide replacements; define initial bad-page count, threshold and per-event arithmetic; supply full table6.5 threshold fields/severity/action, early-stop rule, page-retirement persistence/cleanup, fatal/reset recovery, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Converts an open-ended repeated raw-address sequence into a count-driven, address-safe threshold transition with explicit retirement lifecycle and stop gates.
independent_technical_reasoning: A threshold testcase is about state transition, not the success of individual injections. Without initial count and threshold, three addresses may be too few, excessive or already beyond the boundary. Since retired-page state can persist and addresses may contain live data, each page must be proven disposable and the run must stop as soon as the expected transition occurs.
